high_level_description: The image shows a display of sneakers on a black shelving unit in what appears to be a retail store. The shelves are labeled "LIFESTYLE" with the phrase "Estilo de vida" (Spanish for "lifestyle") underneath each label, indicating that these shoes are part of a lifestyle collection. The sneakers displayed include various models from different brands, but the focus is on a white Nike sneaker circled in red. This particular shoe has a classic design with a white upper and a white sole, featuring the iconic Nike swoosh logo on the side.
